nodes.label: Nightly knowledge curator
nodes.rationale: Reads the last 24h of all sessions (scripts/dump-last-24h.ts), classifies durable knowledge into identity/preferences/domains/conventions, then commits, pushes and posts a digest. Attribution is by session workdir so knowledge from different projects is not lumped together just because it shared one chat window.

nodes.label: Domain digest distillation and inbox drain
nodes.rationale: <topic>.digest.md is the distilled current truth agents read first, synthesized (never copied verbatim) from the previous digest, the dated log and _inbox.md. The curator owns digests; agents only read them. _inbox.md is drained each run and reset to an empty header.

nodes.label: Curator guardrails (no secrets, high-confidence, preserve, skills read-only)
nodes.rationale: Never write secrets even when they appear verbatim in a session; record only durable high-confidence facts and leave doubt out; append by default and remove only on a clear contradiction (noting the supersession); never edit skill code — suggest a skill in the digest instead. CURATOR_DRY_RUN=1 makes the run describe rather than change.
